location: 頭部，百會穴（GV20）前後左右各旁開1寸處，共4個穴位。
locationEn: A group of 4 points at the vertex of the head, 1 cun respectively posterior, anterior, and lateral to Baihui (GV 20).

Subcutaneous insertion 0.5-1.0 cun. Moxibustion applicable.
functions: 鎮靜安神，清頭明目，平肝熄風
functionsEn: Calms the spirit; Pacifies wind; Clears the head and brightens the eyes
cautions: 顱骨未閉合嬰幼兒慎用。
evidence: WHO Extra Points Standard; eLotus CORE.
combinePointsZh:
【失眠】四神聰配神門（HT7）、安眠穴：鎮靜安神助眠。
【頭痛眩暈】四神聰配百會（GV20）、風池（GB20）：清頭明目，止痛定眩。

functions: 清熱消腫，袪風止痛，醒腦明目
functionsEn: Clears heat and reduces swelling; Dispels wind and relieves pain
evidence: WHO Extra Points Standard; eLotus CORE.
combinePointsZh: 【偏頭痛】太陽配率谷（GB8）、風池（GB20）：疏風通絡止痛。

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 太陽 EX-HN5 (eLotus CORE)

location: 耳廓上方，將耳廓向前折疊，耳廓上方頂端處。
locationEn: At the apex of the auricle when the ear is folded forward.
techniqueNotes:

Prick to bleed 3-5 drops. Moxa contraindicated.
functions: 清熱瀉火，解毒明目，平肝降壓

cautions: 點刺放血，徹底消毒。禁灸。
evidence: WHO Extra Points Standard; eLotus CORE.
combinePointsZh: 【麥粒腫】耳尖放血配大椎（GV14）：清熱解毒消腫。

Perpendicular 0.5-1.5 cun. Moxa contraindicated.

functionsEn: Clears heat and brightens eyes; Removes visual obstruction
cautions: 出針後按壓1~2分鐘防出血。禁灸。
evidence: WHO Extra Points Standard; eLotus CORE.

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 球後 EX-HN7 (eLotus CORE)

location: 面部，鼻骨下凹陷中，鼻唇溝上端盡處。
locationEn: On the face, upper end of nasolabial groove, below nasal bone.
techniqueNotes:
斜刺0.3~0.5寸。
Oblique 0.3-0.5 cun.
functionsEn: Clears heat and unblocks the nose; Dispels wind
evidence: WHO Extra Points Standard; eLotus CORE.
combinePointsZh:
【過敏性鼻炎／鼻塞】上迎香配迎香（LI20）、合谷（LI4）：局部通鼻竅，遠端疏風通絡。
【慢性鼻炎／鼻竇炎】上迎香配印堂（EX-HN3）、上星（GV23）：加強鼻竅與前額鼻竇區宣通。

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 上迎香 EX-HN8 (eLotus CORE)

cautions: 鼻旁面部血管神經較密；依 eLotus/AD 以向上斜刺或皮下刺 0.3~0.5 寸為主，避免深刺或向眼眶方向進針。鼻衄、鼻息肉或局部感染時需先判斷出血與感染風險。
cautionsEn: Dense facial vessels and nerves are nearby. Use shallow oblique/subcutaneous needling, usually 0.3-0.5 cun upward per eLotus/AD; avoid deep insertion or needling toward the orbit.
Assess bleeding and infection risk when epistaxis, nasal polyps, or local infection is present.
exam_importance: 經外鼻病要穴。定位抓「迎香 LI20 上內方約0.5寸、鼻唇溝上端」；主軸是通鼻竅，常與迎香、合谷配伍治鼻炎/鼻塞。
exam_pearl: 上迎香 = 鼻通。考點不是一般面痛穴，而是鼻竅專穴：過敏性鼻炎、鼻塞、鼻竇炎、嗅覺減退優先想到。
combinePointsEn:
Allergic rhinitis / nasal obstruction: Shangyingxiang with Yingxiang (LI20) and Hegu (LI4) opens the nasal passages locally and dispels Wind distally.
Chronic rhinitis / sinusitis: combine with Yintang (EX-HN3) and Shangxing (GV23) to emphasize the nasal and frontal-sinus region.
clinical_pearls: 又名鼻通，臨床定位可沿鼻唇溝向上摸到鼻骨下凹陷；鼻塞、嗅覺減退、過敏性鼻炎常與 LI20 形成局部鼻竅對穴。

locationEn: Inside the nostril, on the mucosa at the junction of nasal cartilage and concha.
techniqueNotes:

Prick to bleed with lancet.
functionsEn: Clears heat and disperses Lung; Detoxifies and opens orifices

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 內迎香 EX-HN9

location: 口腔內，舌背正中縫的中點。
locationEn: In the oral cavity, at the midpoint of the median dorsum of the tongue.
techniqueNotes:
直刺0.1~0.2寸，或點刺出血。
Perpendicular 0.1-0.2 cun; or prick to bleed.
functions: 袪痰開竅，調脾和胃，利舌降氣
functionsEn: Transforms phlegm; Harmonizes spleen/stomach; Benefits tongue
evidence: WHO Extra Points Standard; eLotus CORE.

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 聚泉 EX-HN10

cautions: 舌體穴位，僅宜淺刺 0.1~0.2 寸或點刺出血；避免深刺。口腔內操作需嚴格消毒，凝血異常、服抗凝藥或舌部感染者慎用；施術後確認止血。
cautionsEn: Tongue-body point: use only shallow insertion 0.1-0.2 cun or prick to bleed; avoid deep needling.
Strict intraoral sterilization is required. Use caution with bleeding disorders, anticoagulant therapy, or local tongue infection; confirm hemostasis after treatment.
exam_importance: 口舌經外穴。定位在伸舌時舌背正中；主治舌強、失語、舌麻痺，與金津玉液/海泉同屬口舌急症與津液相關穴群。
exam_pearl: 聚泉抓「舌背中央」；金津玉液抓「舌下兩側靜脈」。舌強失語可把聚泉放在口舌穴群核心。
combinePointsZh:
【舌強失語】聚泉配廉泉（CV23）、金津（EX-HN12）、玉液（EX-HN13）：局部利舌開音，兼清熱生津。
【中風後失語】聚泉配風池（GB20）、曲池（LI11）、內關（PC6）：息風通絡、醒神開音。
combinePointsEn:
Tongue stiffness / aphasia: Juquan with Lianquan (CV23), Jinjin (EX-HN12), and Yuye (EX-HN13) benefits the tongue, opens speech, clears Heat, and generates fluids.
Post-stroke aphasia: combine with Fengchi (GB20), Quchi (LI11), and Neiguan (PC6) to extinguish Wind, unblock collaterals, and support speech recovery.
clinical_pearls: Me & Qi 記載此穴安全重點是避免深刺、淺刺為主；古籍與現代資料都把它放在舌強、失語、消渴與舌體病變脈絡中。eLotus 頁面目前可讀性不穩，已保留連結但未把無法開出的頁面當唯一依據。

locationEn: In the oral cavity, at the midpoint of the frenulum of the tongue.

Prick to bleed.
functions: 清熱生津，消腫止痛，利咽開音

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 海泉 EX-HN11 (eLotus CORE)

cautions: 舌下繫帶正中點刺出血，需嚴格消毒並控制出血量；凝血異常、服抗凝藥、口腔/舌下感染或無法配合伸舌者慎用。避免深刺與反覆強刺激。
cautionsEn: Prick to bleed at the midline frenulum; use strict sterilization and control bleeding volume.
Use caution with bleeding disorders, anticoagulant therapy, oral/sublingual infection, or patients unable to cooperate with tongue positioning. Avoid deep needling and repeated strong stimulation.
exam_importance: 海泉位於舌下繫帶中央，在金津、玉液之間。主軸：清熱生津、利舌；與金津玉液同屬口舌腫痛、失語、消渴相關穴群。
exam_pearl: 海泉 = 舌下繫帶中央；金津/玉液 = 舌下左右靜脈。考試容易把三者位置混在一起。
combinePointsZh:
【舌腫痛／蓮花舌】海泉配金津（EX-HN12）、玉液（EX-HN13）、十宣（EX-UE11）：點刺出血以清熱消腫。
【消渴口乾】海泉配廉泉（CV23）、金津玉液：清熱生津、利舌潤燥。
combinePointsEn:
Swollen painful tongue / lotus-flower tongue: Haiquan with Jinjin (EX-HN12), Yuye (EX-HN13), and Shixuan (EX-UE11), usually by bloodletting, clears Heat and reduces swelling.
Wasting-thirst with dry mouth: combine Haiquan with Lianquan (CV23) and Jinjin-Yuye to clear Heat, generate fluids, and benefit the tongue.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 明確列出 heaviness/swelling/pain of tongue、xiao ke、vomiting、abdominal symptoms，故不應只寫「舌炎」；此穴是口舌局部 + 津液/消渴兩條線。

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 金津 EX-HN12 (eLotus CORE)

cautions: 舌下左側靜脈點刺出血，禁深刺；需避開舌下中央繫帶與大血管，控制出血。凝血異常、服抗凝藥、口腔感染或無法配合捲舌者慎用。一般不作留針。
cautionsEn: Prick to bleed on the left sublingual vein; deep needling is contraindicated.

Avoid the central frenulum and major sublingual vessels; control bleeding. Use caution with bleeding disorders, anticoagulant therapy, oral infection, or inability to roll the tongue. Generally do not retain the needle.
exam_importance: 金津為舌下左側靜脈，常與玉液成對使用。主軸：清熱、生津、消腫、利舌；舌腫、口瘡、喉痹、消渴與中風失語要能連起來。
exam_pearl: 金津左、玉液右；多成對點刺出血。位置與海泉不同：海泉在舌下繫帶中央。
combinePointsZh:
【舌腫痛／喉痹】金津配玉液（EX-HN13）、海泉（EX-HN11）：舌下點刺出血，清熱消腫利咽。
【中風失語】金津玉液配聚泉（EX-HN10）、廉泉（CV23）、內關（PC6）：利舌開音、醒神通絡。
【消渴口乾】金津玉液配承漿（CV24）、曲池（LI11）、太衝（LR3）：清熱生津，改善口乾煩渴。
combinePointsEn:
Swollen tongue / throat obstruction: Jinjin with Yuye (EX-HN13) and Haiquan (EX-HN11), often by sublingual bloodletting, clears Heat and reduces swelling.
Post-stroke aphasia: Jinjin-Yuye with Juquan (EX-HN10), Lianquan (CV23), and Neiguan (PC6) benefits the tongue, opens speech, and unblocks collaterals.
Wasting-thirst with dry mouth: Jinjin-Yuye with Chengjiang (CV24), Quchi (LI11), and Taichong (LR3) clears Heat and generates fluids.
clinical_pearls: American Dragon 合併列 Jinjin-Yuye，主治比本地舊卡更完整：口瘡、舌腫、喉痹、失音、中風後失語、消渴、嘔吐與劇烈噁心。Me & Qi 對舌下出血風險寫得更細，安全欄保留其警告方向。

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 玉液 EX-HN13 (eLotus CORE)

cautions: 舌下右側靜脈點刺出血，禁深刺，禁灸；需避開舌下中央繫帶與大血管，控制出血。凝血異常、服抗凝藥、口腔感染或無法配合捲舌者慎用。一般不作留針。
cautionsEn: Prick to bleed on the right sublingual vein; deep needling and moxibustion are contraindicated.

Avoid the central frenulum and major sublingual vessels; control bleeding. Use caution with bleeding disorders, anticoagulant therapy, oral infection, or inability to roll the tongue. Generally do not retain the needle.
exam_importance: 玉液為舌下右側靜脈，與金津成對。主軸：清熱、生津、消腫、利舌；常用於舌腫痛、口瘡、喉痹、消渴與失語。
exam_pearl: 金津左、玉液右；多成對點刺出血。玉液安全重點是舌下靜脈出血風險，不能寫成一般皮膚感染套話。
combinePointsZh:
【舌腫痛／喉痹】玉液配金津（EX-HN12）、海泉（EX-HN11）：舌下點刺出血，清熱消腫利咽。
【中風失語】金津玉液配聚泉（EX-HN10）、廉泉（CV23）、內關（PC6）：利舌開音、醒神通絡。
【消渴口乾】金津玉液配承漿（CV24）、曲池（LI11）、太衝（LR3）：清熱生津，改善口乾煩渴。
combinePointsEn:
Swollen tongue / throat obstruction: Yuye with Jinjin (EX-HN12) and Haiquan (EX-HN11), often by sublingual bloodletting, clears Heat and reduces swelling.
Post-stroke aphasia: Jinjin-Yuye with Juquan (EX-HN10), Lianquan (CV23), and Neiguan (PC6) benefits the tongue, opens speech, and unblocks collaterals.
Wasting-thirst with dry mouth: Jinjin-Yuye with Chengjiang (CV24), Quchi (LI11), and Taichong (LR3) clears Heat and generates fluids.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 將玉液主治收斂為失語/舌強痛腫與嘔吐；AD 與 Me & Qi 補入口瘡、喉痹、消渴、失音、劇烈噁心等。卡片保留來源差異，不把單一來源當共識。

visualLinks.labelZh: 經外奇穴 · 翳明 EX-HN14 (eLotus CORE)

cautions: 頸部近乳突、耳後與上頸部結構，依 eLotus 以直刺 0.5~0.8 寸為準；避免過深或向顱底/咽喉深部方向進針。局部感染、腫塊或術後瘢痕處慎用。
cautionsEn: Posterior-auricular/upper-neck structures are nearby. Use perpendicular insertion 0.5-0.8 cun per eLotus; avoid deep insertion or directing the needle toward the skull base or deep throat.
Use caution with local infection, masses, or postsurgical scarring.
exam_importance: 眼耳與安神相關經外穴。定位在翳風 TE17 後 1 寸；與安眠、風池區域接近，但主軸偏眼病/耳鳴。
exam_pearl: 翳明不要和安眠混：翳明在 TE17 後 1 寸，主眼病與耳鳴；安眠在 TE17-GB20 中點，主失眠。
combinePointsZh:
【眼病／視力問題】翳明配睛明（BL1）、光明（GB37）、太陽（EX-HN5）：明目退翳。
【耳鳴】翳明配翳風（TE17）、聽宮（SI19）、中渚（TE3）：疏通耳周少陽經氣。
combinePointsEn:
Eye disorders / visual problems: Yiming with Jingming (BL1), Guangming (GB37), and Taiyang (EX-HN5) benefits the eyes and clears visual obstruction.
Tinnitus: Yiming with Yifeng (TE17), Tinggong (SI19), and Zhongzhu (TE3) unblocks the Shaoyang channel network around the ear.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 對翳明的內容很精簡：眼病、耳鳴、失眠；技法 0.5~0.8 寸。原本本地卡 0.5~1.0 寸與可灸需要後續用課件/其他來源再確認。

combinePointsEn:
Chronic cough / asthma: Jingbailao with Feishu (BL13), Dingchuan (EX-B1), and Shanzhong (CV17) supports Lung Qi, transforms Phlegm, and calms wheezing.

Insomnia: Anmian with Shenmen (HT7) and Sanyinjiao (SP6) calms the spirit and supports Heart-Kidney communication.
